description: This Java class 'JavaScriptMessageMapperFactory' serves as a factory for creating instances of JavaScript message mappers and their configurations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides static methods to create configuration builders and message mapper instances using the Rhino JavaScript engine.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to produce JavaScript message mappers and their configurations, intended for use with the Rhino JavaScript engine.

methods.name: createJavaScriptMessageMapperConfigurationBuilder
methods.description: Builds a configuration builder for JavaScript message mappers, initializing it with provided properties.

methods.name: createJavaScriptMessageMapperRhino
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a JavaScript message mapper based on the Rhino engine.
